title: Rooftops are changing the electricity mix
caption: Estimated distributed-solar share of total electricity generation, FY23 and FY25.
note: Updated estimate, published June 2026. Includes modelled behind-the-meter generation. This is a generation share, not utility-scale installed capacity; the two charts use different denominators.

title: Pakistan’s LNG supply is concentrated in one route
caption: Share of LNG imports supplied by Qatar and the UAE; March 2026 assessment.
note: Updated to the March 2026 IEEFA assessment, citing Kpler. These supplier shares measure imported LNG, not total gas use. Supplies from Qatar and the UAE depend on passage through the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Fewer units can carry the same fixed bill
caption: Illustrative fixed-cost recovery, with the annual fixed bill held constant.
note: Illustration, not observed data or a forecast. Index = 100 × 100 ÷ units sold. A 20% fall in sales raises fixed cost per unit by 25% only if fixed costs are unchanged. Fuel savings, taxes, tariff design and changes to contracts are excluded.
source: Dark Matter illustration of fixed-cost recovery

title: Most of the promised emissions cut needs outside support
caption: Pakistan’s NDC 3.0 ambition for 2035, relative to projected business-as-usual emissions.
note: Policy target, not achieved reductions. The 17- and 33-percentage-point components together form a 50% reduction against projected 2035 emissions. The conditional component depends on international finance, technology transfer and capacity support; this does not show funding already raised.

title: Batteries are following panels onto rooftops
caption: Annual lithium-ion battery energy storage imports, including telecom systems.
note: Updated estimate, published July 2026. Uses the sector breakdown’s 1.43 and 4.59 GWh totals; the report rounds 2025 to 4.6 GWh and reports growth of about 220%. Cumulative imports over 2018–2025 were 7.6 GWh. Imports do not measure operating storage, and GWh is not interchangeable with GW.
source: Renewables First, Pakistan’s Battery Boom Begins, July 2026

title: Solar’s protection against fuel shocks has an economic value
caption: Avoided oil and gas imports: a cumulative estimate and a separate conditional projection.
note: Updated analysis published March 2026 and revised in April. The second figure assumes elevated fuel prices persist; it is not a realised 2026 result. The two periods differ, so these figures are shown separately rather than as an annual trend or a combined total.
source: CREA, with contributions from Renewables First, March/April 2026
